title: Quantum Vision Theory Applied to Audio Classification for Deepfake Speech Detection
abstract: arXiv:2604.08104v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose Quantum Vision (QV) theory as a new perspective for deep learning-based audio classification, applied to deepfake speech detection. Inspired by particle-wave duality in quantum physics, QV theory is based on the idea that data can be represented not only in its observable, collapsed form, but also as information waves. In conventional deep learning, models are trained directly on these collapsed representations, such as images. In QV theory, inputs are first transformed into information waves using a QV block, and then fed into deep learning models for classification. translated_title: 量子视觉理论在音频分类中应用于深伪语音检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出量子视觉理论作为一种基于深度学习的音频分类新视角，并将其应用于深伪语音检测。受量子物理学中波粒二象性的启发，量子视觉理论基于这样一种理念：数据不仅可以以其可观测的坍缩形式表示，还可以作为信息波来表示。在传统深度学习中，模型直接在这些坍缩表示（如图像）上进行训练。而在量子视觉理论中，输入首先通过量子视觉块转换为信息波，然后再输入深度学习模型进行分类。基于量子视觉的模型在图像分类任务中相较于非量子视觉对应模型提升了性能。那么，如果将量子视觉理论应用于语音频谱图进行音频分类任务会怎样？这正是所提出方法的动机与创新之处。在这项工作中，语音信号的短时傅里叶变换（STFT）、梅尔频谱图和梅尔频率倒谱系数（MFCC）
tldr: 本文提出量子视觉理论这一新视角，将语音频谱图先转换为信息波再输入深度学习模型进行分类，以提升深伪语音检测的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Quantum Vision theory as a new perspective that transforms speech spectrograms into information waves before feeding them into deep learning models, improving deepfake speech detection performance.
